title: Tradeify list prices and homepage promotions can diverge
summary: Tradeify's June 24 pricing reference maps 12 base purchases to account sizes, while the homepage advertises a changing percentage promotion and its server-readable pricing cards contain placeholder values.
traderImpact: The comparison stores the stable list price, not a temporary coupon. Confirm the final discounted amount, reset cost, and product name in the logged-in checkout before paying.

title: LucidDaily launched with 4 configurable evaluation paths
summary: LucidDaily combines DLL On or Off with Intraday or EOD evaluation drawdown. Every funded version switches to Intraday drawdown and permits daily payout requests after its buffer gate.
traderImpact: The selected drawdown and DLL change both risk mechanics and price. Lucid did not expose stable public dollar prices during capture, so compare the exact checkout configuration rather than a generic LucidDaily fee.

title: Apex moved new purchases to 4 one-time evaluation paths
summary: Products bought after 1 March 2026 use Intraday or EOD drawdown with Standard or No Activation Fee pricing. The prior recurring products are Legacy.
traderImpact: Older Apex reviews can describe a different billing and drawdown structure. Match any comparison to the product name shown at checkout.

title: TradeDay monthly prices were tied to a 55%-off promotion
summary: The captured monthly fees used the TDNEW promotion shown on TradeDay's own product cards. Those prices can move when the campaign changes or ends.
traderImpact: Treat the table price as a dated checkout snapshot, not a permanent subscription rate. Recheck the first month and reset price before paying.

title: FundingPips separates the current Standard path from legacy 10% resets
summary: The current 2 Step Standard Phase 1 target is 8%. FundingPips says legacy Standard accounts carrying a 10% target reset as 2 Step Flex.
traderImpact: A reset can place an older account into a different product rule set. Confirm the product name and target after any reset.

title: Alpha Capital's own pages disagree on a 25K Pro price
summary: One official cost page states $137 for the 25K Alpha Pro 6% variant, while a separate official review page states $197 for a 25K Alpha Pro without identifying the target variant.
traderImpact: The $137 figure is retained only for the explicitly labelled 6% product. Verify the selected target and final checkout total before purchase.
